description: Turn an agent/agentic_pipeline-step dict result into a DataFrame.

inputs.description: Upstream agent (or any dict-valued) asset's materialized result

outputs.description: One row per run (or per exploded/extracted item), ready for a dataframe_to_* sink

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key -- an agent asset, an agentic_pipeline step asset, or any dict-valued asset.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: 'one_row': one row per run, built from the result dict's own scalar fields (final_answer, iterations, tool_calls_made, ... whatever the upstream actually has). 'explode': one row per entry of a list-valued field (see explode_field). 'extract': parse `final_answer` as JSON (or a fenced ```json block) into columns/rows -- for agents prompted to return structured output.

explode_field.label: Explode Field
explode_field.description: mode='explode' only: the list-valued field to explode, one output row per entry.

on_parse_error.label: On Parse Error
on_parse_error.description: mode='extract' only. 'raise' (default): fail the run with a clear error on invalid JSON. 'keep_raw': instead emit one row with the raw text under final_answer_raw and the error message under parse_error, so a single bad response doesn't break the asset.

include_columns.label: Include Columns
include_columns.description: Only keep these columns from each row (run/extra columns are always added). Default: every scalar field present.

exclude_columns.label: Exclude Columns
exclude_columns.description: Drop these columns from the default/explicit column set.

add_run_columns.label: Add Run Columns
add_run_columns.description: Add run_id, partition_key, materialized_at, and asset_key columns to every row. Needed so history accumulates correctly in a table a dataframe_to_* sink appends to.

extra_columns.label: Extra Columns
extra_columns.description: Extra literal columns stamped onto every row, e.g. {pipeline: 'daily_digest', run_date: '{partition_key}'}. The literal substring '{partition_key}' is replaced with the current partition key (empty string when unpartitioned).

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners -- team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. python, pandas). Defaults to python/pandas if empty.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Useful for transient errors like network glitches or rate limits.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'cron', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned. Match the upstream agent asset's own partitioning.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only.

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (default) excludes the current, still-in-progress window; 1 includes it.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC).

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one run (the partition-bridge handling produces one row group per partition in the range). 'multi_run' launches one run per partition. Leave empty for Dagster's default. Ignored when Partition Type is not set.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Policy Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For backfill_policy='multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave unset for Dagster's default (1 partition per run).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b'.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides the flat partition fields.
